description: This script searches for specific log files within a directory, processes them with an external tool 'gqui' to extract protobuf entries, and outputs the results to text files while capturing errors. It is used for parsing and extracting metrics logs related to 'cuttlefish' and 'atest' in the Android platform.

methods.name: FindLogFiles
methods.description: Searches for log files within a given directory containing a specified string in their filename.
